subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` change, or continue only through the broad Slack action-parity PR?
rationale: The requested feature is valid and source-reproducible, but an overlapping broad PR already exists with protected human-review and security/compatibility concerns, so automation should not queue a duplicate implementation without maintainer direction.

options.title: Split focused discovery work
options.body: Land a small Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack action expansion for separate review.

options.title: Continue broad parity PR
options.body: Use the broad Slack action-parity PR as the canonical path and close this issue only after it merges with proof and risk resolved.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep this accepted feature request open without queuing repair until maintainers are ready to expand the Slack action surface.

recommendation.title: Split focused discovery work
recommendation.body: Land a small Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack action expansion for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping broad Slack parity PR and have the strongest recent Slack action/docs history among the routing candidates.
